exposure: Single-layer closure at previous caesarean delivery
outcome: Complete uterine rupture during TOLAC at term
cohort: Women in the Danish Medical Birth Registry (DMBR) during 1997-2008 with a singleton pregnancy at term and trial of vaginal birth after caesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Single-layer uterine closure was not significantly associated with uterine rupture during TOLAC at term after adjusting for confounding factors.
